name: Coq au vin lite
steps: Brown the chicken thigh pieces in a little olive oil.
Add the mushrooms, onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Pour in the red wine and let it reduce by half.
Add the chicken stock and a sprig of thyme, then simmer 20 minutes.
Stir the sliced carrot through for the last 10 minutes.
Reduce the sauce until glossy and serve hot.
